capabilities: Add a mode-switch button to the file header
Toggle between Source and Live Preview
Optionally cycle through Reading mode in a configurable order
Show all mode buttons with the active one highlighted
Expose CSS classes for custom styling
extras: Works only if Live Preview and the file header are enabled; installable via BRAT or from releases.
problem: Obsidian offers no quick one-click way in the file header to flip between editing modes while working in a note.
summary: File-header button that switches a note between Source and Live Preview modes, optionally including Reading mode.
